## Learning outcomes
- By the end of this session you will
  - Understand the six key dplyr verbs

---

## Note
- We focus on the implementation of these ideas in dplyr
- One thing that the LLMs have done is make translation between languages straightforward
- You can apply the same concepts to any program/language - the key thing is having the conceptual language to describe what you want to do, rather than the technical implementation

## What is dplyr
- dplyr is a popular R package for data manipulation
- part of the tidyverse
- the same operations are included in other R packages (base; data.table) and programs (python; Stata; SQL; SPSS)



```{r}

library(tibble)
library(dplyr)

df <- tibble(
  cat1 = c(rep("a", 3), rep("b", 3), rep("c", 3)),
  cat2 = c("j", "j", "k", "j", "k", "k", "j", "j", "k"),
  x = 1:9
)

```

## Operations on rows
- `filter`
- `arrange`
- `distinct`

## filter

```{r}
#| echo: true
df

```

## filter

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  filter(cat1 == "a")

```

## filter

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  filter(cat1 == "b")

```

## filter

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  filter(cat1 != "b")

```

## arrange

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  arrange(cat2)

```

## arrange

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  arrange(desc(cat2))

```


## distinct

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  distinct(cat1)

```

## distinct

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  distinct(cat2)

```

## distinct

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  distinct(cat1, cat2)

```


## Operations on columns

- `mutate`
- `select`
- `rename`

## select

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  select(cat1)

```

## select
```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  select(cat1, x)

```

## select
```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  select(contains("cat")) # note the ""!

```

## rename
```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  rename(category_1 = cat1) # new name comes first

```


## Operations on groups

- `summarise`
- `group_by`

## Summarise

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  summarise(
    avg = mean(x),
    total = sum(x),
    n = n()
  )

```


## Summarise {.smaller}

{{< video images/grp-summarize-00.mp4 >}}

## group_by 

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  group_by(cat1) |> 
  summarise(
    avg = mean(x),
    total = sum(x),
    n = n()
  )

```

## group_by 

```{r}
#| echo: true
df |> 
  group_by(cat2) |> 
  summarise(
    avg = mean(x),
    total = sum(x),
    n = n()
  )

```

